Learned apprentice fishing and the Fish Bowl recipe
Level 18 Skyborne hunter; level 17 after Hall of Thanes turn-ins and 18 in Moonbrook
Completed first Hall of Thanes run with Alaric Dawnward, Gjoran Ashbrand, Luka Li and Krondum Icewind
Defeated Faldrim Anvilmar, Magmatus, Plunder and Durgen Dirgehammer; ForeverJournal labels the fire encounter Infurnus
Recovered Treaty of Understanding and delivered it to King Magni Bronzebeard
Received Calibrated Blunderbuss and trained Guns; cosmetic bow appearance was intended, completion unverified
Learned Claw and Bite in Loch Modan; player reported teaching Sylthara rank 3

Trained pet Great Stamina Rank 3 and Natural Armor Rank 3
Recorded death in Jangolode Mine; subsequently continued questing
Reached level 19 at Lordamere Overlook and was level 20 by Lakeshire.
Defeated Witherfang, the Baron (encounter header The Butcher), the Abandoned, Bjork, Rath’mael, and Viktor the Vile in that order.
Earned journeyman leatherworking and reached skill 65.
Obtained the sleeping bag, reached level 22 in the Wetlands and level 23 in Stormwind, and trained Hunter’s Mark Rank 2 and Scorpid Sting.
Cleared Deadmines with Valerio Thalric, Elder Burnberry, Kelthan Swiftstrike, Scout Ilthen, and Sylthara. Recovered after the wipe following Sneed.
Reached level 24 while working in Wetlands and level 25 after the Redridge rescue of Corporal Keeshan on November 13.

Completed Shadowfang Keep with Tess Reitveld, Grannie Goodness, Vern Wallston, Rel Puresilver, and Sylthara; defeated Rethilgore, Razorclaw, Baron Silverlaine, Springvale, Odo, Fenrus, Nandos and Arugal.

Trained Sylthara further and worked on First Aid after reaching level 25.
character_continuity: High Order hunter, true name Aelindra Ser'jaen'thal. Blue Gale and Zephyr tattoos and her mother's pearls.
Grouped with Neranduil Zephyrgale for the Cirrusfly Queen and with Merith Gustwing and Evayne Greystorm for Vulgara.
Tamed the young Prideclaw Sylthara in the Shen’dar Highlands at 05:50 Eastern. Later journaled in the Gustberry Lowlands that Sylthara was her best friend.
Escorted Aamelia Windfield during Standing Our Ground and witnessed the orchard’s cyclone construct deal with Ferauu.
Witnessed Elaadrin and Ayessa stand together against Lorthuna at the Rohashi Spires. Ansirem Runeweaver and Muln Earthfury arrived before Rohash withdrew.
Left Zephras Isle by skycutter to Dalaran, then took the one-way portal to Stormwind.

Now knows Edwin VanCleef led the Stonemasons’ Guild and that the masons who rebuilt Stormwind became the Defias Brotherhood. Their reasons and full grievance remain unresolved in her knowledge; preserve this boundary.
Helped with Alba Fairmoon’s investigation into poisoned Westfall water and prepared explosives for the forge beneath Moonbrook.
Read about the War of the Three Hammers at an inn in Stormwind’s Dwarven District.
Searched all day for a Ruins of Lordaeron group without entering it, per Bryan’s account.
Cleared the Ruins of Lordaeron with Egg Eggon, Mia Lichlore, Elkon Norres, Aldrin Stockholm, and Sylthara.
Hired Bram Copperkeep as her Adventurer’s Factor by letter and sent him an enchanted belt.
Swam from Westfall to Booty Bay to avoid the dangers of inland Stranglethorn, then traveled via Ratchet to the Barrens and camped in Desolace with Sylthara.

On November 12, learned that Stormwind’s stonemasons went unpaid and their guild was dissolved. She sympathizes with their demand for wages and questions what the Brotherhood did to Westfall. Delivered VanCleef’s unsent letter to Baros Alexston.
Met Harrend Hardholler while helping in Wetlands; the encounter went badly, but was friendly.
Joined Tess Reitveld, Grannie Goodness, Vern Wallston and Rel Puresilver for Shadowfang Keep; shared humor and survived Arugal but struggled with straggling behind on the way out.
Helped Ranya Sunwisp and Thorsten Steelbeard in Redridge; invited the dwarf along and escorted Corporal Keeshan.
Continues researching the Wetlands excavation lead and gathering Stockades assignments; do not claim either dungeon has been cleared.
